resampling.convention: Deterministic linear interpolation from plant.run_trial traces onto the common comparison grid.
resampling.time_grid_rule: Inclusive endpoints from 0.00 s to 3.60 s at 0.01 s spacing; times are rounded to two decimals.
resampling.bar_velocity_m_s: Computed by centered finite differences on the resampled bar displacement signal.

weighing_phase.Wsys: Mean Fz_total over the final stable 1.00 s of the 1.50 s weighing phase.
weighing_phase.quiet_force_sd: Population standard deviation of Fz_total over the same final stable 1.00 s weighing window.

force_definitions.Fz_left: Source-authoritative left force-platform vertical force in N.
force_definitions.Fz_right: Source-authoritative right force-platform vertical force in N.
force_definitions.Fz_total: Bilateral force-platform vertical force, defined as Fz_left + Fz_right in N.

event_rules.movement_onset: First post-weighing sustained drop below Wsys minus max(5 x quiet_force_sd, 20 N), sustained for 0.050 s.
event_rules.takeoff: First sustained no-foot-contact interval after the valid propulsive phase, sustained for 0.025 s.

mechanics_validity_contract.primary_truth: Validation derives validity from plant rollout force/contact/root/foot-clearance telemetry.
mechanics_validity_contract.phase_requirement: All seven phase indices must be observed in the rollout.
mechanics_validity_contract.lpt_rule: Passive LPT/bar traces cannot override failed force/contact validity.

jump_height.hIM: Impulse-momentum jump height computed as v_takeoff^2/(2g).

lpt.interpretation: LPT displacement and velocity are bar-only measurements and not COM measurements.

measurement_surface.force_aggregation: fz_total_N equals fz_left_N + fz_right_N after deterministic resampling.
measurement_surface.force_realization: The declared total-force noise realization is apportioned across the physical left/right force traces before resampling so aggregation remains exact.
